scenario: [LCCO.2.2]: an `on` clause over the response, a `timeout` clause naming a duration and an `error` clause, all three on one `call`, compile together. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: which case label fires is a runtime question this does not observe. LCCO.14.1, the id, is a tombstone.
rules_ds:
schema SvcMethodReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    v: Int

service svc.method:
    """stub"""
    response SvcMethodReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call svc.method cooldown: 30_s
        on response.v > 0:
            log info "ok"
        timeout 5_s:
            log info "timeout"
        error:
            log info "error"
